public_definitions: The goal is to use the dashboard trend to route the inpatient capacity review to the most appropriate operations pathway for the current period.
The chart is titled 'Operational trend view: COVID-19 hospital census over time'.
The primary field label is 'Operational routing decision'.

The three options are: 'Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand', 'Route to step-down recovery planning for easing COVID-19 inpatient demand', and 'Route to routine respiratory surveillance updates for background monitoring'.

The companion fields include 'note', 'visible_context_1' (Program area: Clinical Care), 'visible_context_2' (Review scope: COVID-19 inpatient capacity), and 'visible_context_3' (Workflow stage: Capacity planning triage).
The page instructions direct the user to use the dashboard trend for routing.
The chart is the only visual element provided for making the routing decision.
